subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the perimeter of a shape by adding side lengths
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student traces around a virtual shape's edge with a measuring tool, adding as they go
exercise.pictorial: Student adds labeled side lengths shown on a pictured shape
exercise.abstract: Student calculates perimeter from a written list of side lengths

misconception_flags: counts a side twice or skips a side when adding around the shape

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
